insights.headline: Prioritise companies building a design bench
insights.body: Multiple open design roles at the same company are a stronger application signal than a single isolated posting.

insights.headline: Use the published Bengaluru senior band as the India pay anchor
insights.body: Indian employers in this crawl published too few senior pay bands to report from postings (n=0). The tier-2 published Bengaluru senior benchmark is ₹1,200,000–₹3,500,000, median ₹2,200,000 (reported, Payscale India UX/Product Designer plus reported 2025-26 city-market composite). No current CTC is present in the committed profile, so the build can state the target band but not the personal gap.
